Storage.//: S3 (RustFS) now, OneDrive when PGN grants tenant access. Credentials injected.

S3.//ForcePathStyle: Required. RustFS supports path-style addressing only unless server domains are configured; without this the SDK resolves bucket.rustfs and fails to connect.

Upload.//: Raise together with nginx client_max_body_size and Kestrel MaxRequestBodySize, or you get a 413 at the layer you forgot.

Auth.//: Deployment configuration, not an admin screen — Identity binds these at AddIdentity().

Smtp.//: Built but disabled — email is deferred. Password injected.
